actions.label: wi-fi
actions.command: sh -c '[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && nmcli radio wifi on || nmcli radio wifi off'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[ "$(nmcli radio wifi)" = enabled ] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: bluetooth
actions.command: sh -c '[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && bluetoothctl power on || bluetoothctl power off'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'bluetoothctl show | grep -q "Powered: yes" && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: airplane
actions.command: sh -c '[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && nmcli radio all off || nmcli radio all on'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[ "$(nmcli radio wifi)" = disabled ] && [ "$(nmcli radio wwan)" != enabled ] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: night light
actions.command: sh -c '[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ] && (pgrep -x wlsunset || setsid wlsunset -T 4500 -t 3500 >/dev/null 2>&1 &) || pkill -x wlsunset'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'pgrep -x wlsunset >/dev/null && echo true || echo false'
